title: Your Outdoor Living Lead Engine: 60-Minute GHL and Claude Review

sections.label: 1 - WORKFLOW REVIEW (20 MIN)
sections.note: Your intake/lead-routing workflow first, then the 8 follow-ups: speed-to-lead, consult reminders, proposal chase, nurture, reactivation, reviews and referrals. Anything that overlaps an older workflow goes on your list.

sections.label: 2 - CLAUDE STRATEGY (15 MIN)
sections.note: Claude already reads and writes your contacts, tags and opportunities through the connector. Timed messages stay in GHL, judgment calls go to Claude, and tags pass the work between them.

sections.label: 3 - TESTING AND REPORTING (15 MIN)
sections.note: Your two silent failures: empty merge fields and leads that never enter a workflow. GHL catches the first before the send, and Claude finds the second by the missing tag.

sections.label: 4 - NEXT STEPS (10 MIN)
sections.note: Your prioritized list of improvements, in writing after the call. The fixes that protect the most leads come first.

nodes.label: 1 - We meet for 60 minutes on Zoom or Google Meet, with your GHL on screen
2 - We follow one new lead through your intake and lead-routing workflow
3 - We check the triggers, branching, timing and routing of your 8 follow-ups
4 - Does an older workflow fire on the same trigger? We mark which one stays
5 - Anything instant or timed stays in GHL, like speed-to-lead and consult reminders
6 - A webhook sends each reply to Claude, and Claude's tag starts proposal chase or nurture
7 - Each workflow adds an entry tag in its first step, so Claude can see who entered it
8 - An If/Else step before each message checks that its merge fields are filled in
9 - A field is blank? The message waits and you get a task to fill it in
10 - Claude looks only for new leads with no entry tag, not through all ~2,400 contacts
11 - Claude sends you one report: blank fields, missed leads, anyone stuck in a pipeline
12 - After the call, you get your prioritized list in writing, leads at risk first

prioritized_improvements.fix: If/Else before every send in the 8 follow-ups: a blank first name holds the message and opens a task
prioritized_improvements.why: A blank merge field reaches the homeowner as is

prioritized_improvements.fix: Each of the 9 workflows adds an entry tag in its first step; Claude lists contacts past intake with none
prioritized_improvements.why: A lead that never enters a workflow gets no follow-up and nobody sees it

prioritized_improvements.fix: Older workflow on the same trigger as speed-to-lead: turn it off
Claude tags the reply category; the tag starts proposal chase or nurture in GHL
prioritized_improvements.why: Judgment stays with Claude, timing stays in GHL
